t: A Tablet Scanner is a tablet state used for remote access to a linked Storage Scanner.
平板电脑（检测器）是一种用于远程访问已链接存储检测器的平板电脑状态。
Link a Storage Control Module to a Storage Scanner, put that module in a tablet, and select it. Right-click opens the remote scanner GUI.
将存储控制模块链接至存储检测器，再将该模块插入平板电脑并选中。右键点击即可打开远程扫描器GUI。
Sneak right-click opens the tablet management GUI instead. Remote use consumes FE from the tablet according to the scanner tablet cost.
潜行右键点击将打开平板电脑管理GUI。远程使用时，将根据扫描平板电脑的消耗标准，从平板电脑中扣除FE。
